_meta.source: Ministry of Jal Shakti programme websites; CGWB; NITI Aayog Composite Water Management Index reports.

national.name: Jal Jeevan Mission (JJM) — Har Ghar Jal
national.ministry: Jal Shakti — Department of Drinking Water & Sanitation
national.purpose: Functional Household Tap Connection (FHTC) to every rural household by 2024 (extended). Includes water quality remediation in priority habitations (arsenic, fluoride, iron, salinity, nitrate).

national.name: AMRUT 2.0 (Atal Mission for Rejuvenation and Urban Transformation)
national.purpose: Universal coverage of water supply in all statutory towns; sewerage/septage management; rejuvenation of urban water bodies.

national.name: Atal Bhujal Yojana (ABHY)
national.purpose: Community-led, demand-side groundwater management in over-exploited blocks. Active in Gujarat, Haryana, Karnataka, MP, Maharashtra, Rajasthan, UP.

national.name: Namami Gange Programme
national.ministry: Jal Shakti — National Mission for Clean Ganga
national.purpose: Clean Ganga and tributaries: sewage treatment, riverfront development, biodiversity, afforestation.

national.name: National River Conservation Plan (NRCP)
national.purpose: Pollution abatement of rivers other than Ganga across 16 states.

national.name: Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana (PMKSY)
national.purpose: Per Drop More Crop, watershed development, micro-irrigation — reduces agricultural water demand.

national.name: Mission Amrit Sarovar
national.purpose: Develop/rejuvenate at least 75 water bodies (amrit sarovars) per district.

national.name: Swachh Bharat Mission (Grameen) Phase II
national.purpose: ODF Plus, greywater management, faecal sludge management — reduces microbial contamination of water sources.

national.name: National Aquifer Mapping & Management Programme (NAQUIM)
national.purpose: Aquifer-level characterisation and management plans across India.
